прощення.text: Possibly from Old Church Slavonic прощениѥ (proštenije). By surface analysis, прощ- (prošč-, stem of прости́ти (prostýty)) + -ення (-ennja, verbal-noun-forming suffix), with stress on the suffix (i.e. проще́ння) rather than the usual/expected stress retraction to the verb stem (which would produce про́щення). Compare Russian проще́ние (proščénije).
